
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22223623" title="发布于 2026-08-04 20:38">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">1. DeepAgents 开箱，鸿蒙自动化测试 Agent 框架跑通</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>DeepAgents 是什么？一句话说，它是一个开箱即用的 Agent Harness——智能体运行支架。</p>
<p>很多时候，大家做 Agent 卡在哪？不是模型不够聪明，而是规划、读写文件、长上下文、子任务协作这些「硬骨头」得自己一块块接。DeepAgents 把这些能力内置好了，而且不是演示用的附属功能，而是奔着多步骤、长链路任务去的生产级底座。具体包括：</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>自动任务规划（Planning）</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>文件系统读写（Filesystem）</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>子 Agent 协作（Sub Agents）&nbsp;</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>上下文压缩与管理（Context Management）</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>长任务执行（Long Running Tasks）</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>人工审批（Human-in-the-Loop）</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>持久化记忆（Memory）</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="324">
<p>流式输出（Streaming）</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1htKA6VEmC/" rel="noopener nofollow">《1. DeepAgents 开箱，鸿蒙自动化测试 Agent 框架跑通》</a>。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="554.77" data-width="2560" data-height="1044" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/e78499b5f10f0e060c877024739aef173546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260804203820777-490668266.png"></p>
<p>别把它当成另起炉灶的新框架。DeepAgents 站在 LangChain / LangGraph 之上：LangChain 提供零件，LangGraph 提供引擎与编排，DeepAgents 则把生产级能力预先装好，让你能直接上手。若你还没有 LangChain 基础，建议先补一补上一个合集，再回来会顺很多。</p>
<p>三层大致可以这样理解：</p>
<p>LangChain：Model、Prompt、Tool、Retriever、Output Parser</p>
<p>LangGraph：状态管理、工作流编排、节点与边、Checkpoint 持久化</p>
<p>DeepAgents：任务规划、文件系统、子 Agent、上下文压缩、长任务执行、人工审批、持久化记忆、流式输出</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="325.21" data-width="2560" data-height="1000" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/a21075ce5415eee13513ae1c219ff5373546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260804203820705-1165714337.png"></p>
<p>选型也不用纠结「哪个更高级」，按链路长短判断就行。</p>
<p>LangChain 更适合短链路、路径清晰的场景，比如 FAQ / 智能客服、知识库问答（RAG）、轻量工具助手。一旦任务变成多步闭环、还要可靠交付，DeepAgents 就更合适——多步业务闭环 Agent、文档密集型流程，以及我们后面要做的鸿蒙自动化测试 Agent，都属于这一类。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="237.5" data-width="2560" data-height="904" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/14f812179e267f94fd3998ec590b84313546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260804203820592-1126502631.png"></p>
<p>鸿蒙自动化测试正好拿来检验长任务能力：从读需求到出报告，链路够长，步骤也够细。本课主线就是这六步闭环：</p>
<p>①&nbsp;&nbsp; 读取需求文档&nbsp; ② 生成测试用例&nbsp; ③ 测试前截图 ④ 执行测试 ⑤ 测试后截图 ⑥ 生成报告</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="264.38" data-width="2560" data-height="960" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/594e6d04d65671c945863038e0208f7a3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260804203820652-875918192.png"></p>
<p><strong>理论说到这，接下来进入代码实战。</strong></p>
<p>首先安装需要的开发库：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install python-dotenv deepagents langchain-openai</pre>
</div>
<p>大模型参数配置方面的内容，我们在学习 LangChain 时讲过好多遍了，这里就不再重复了。参数文件.env内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">填上你的API KEY </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">访问URL地址</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
MODEL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模型名称</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>接着从 deepagents 里导入 create_deep_agent。按官网的说法，它就是 deepagents 的主入口：日常创建智能体，核心就用这一个函数。作用是创建一个具备规划、工具调用和上下文管理能力的 Deep Agent，后面所有功能都围绕它来跑。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> deepagents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> create_deep_agent</pre>
</div>
<p>在调用 create_deep_agent 时，有几个关键参数需要了解：</p>
<p>①&nbsp; model 指定智能体用哪一个大模型</p>
<p>②&nbsp; system_prompt 是系统提示词，用来规定智能体的角色和行为</p>
<p>③&nbsp; debug 打开调试模式，可以查看运行过程中的详细信息，方便排查问题</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent(
        model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
        system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HarmonyOS 自动化测试专家。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True
    )</span></pre>
</div>
<p>智能体创建好了之后，接着在 main 函数中，先调用 create_test_agent 创建智能体实例，然后用 invoke 方法发起一次对话。传入的是一个字典，messages 里放消息列表；每条消息有 role 和 content，role 是 user 表示用户提问，content 就是具体要求。</p>
<p>结果里的 messages 保存了整轮对话，我们取最后一条消息，也就是智能体的最终回复，再从 content 内容里把文本取出来打印。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent()
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke(
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用3行列出 HarmonyOS 自动化测试3步流程，每行一句，禁止扩展。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]})
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>])</pre>
</div>
<p>run_automation_test.py完整代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> deepagents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent

load_dotenv()
os.environ[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
os.environ[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
model </span>= f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai:{os.getenv('MODEL')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>


<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent(
        model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
        system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HarmonyOS 自动化测试专家。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True
    )


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent()
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke(
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用3行列出 HarmonyOS 自动化测试3步流程，每行一句，禁止扩展。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]})
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    main()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>运行这段代码，你就拥有了一个具备鸿蒙自动化测试专家角色定位的智能体。虽然这只是一个最简单的示例，但它已经跑通了 DeepAgents 的核心流程。在此基础上，我们可以逐步添加文件读取、截图工具、测试执行等能力，最终构建出完整的鸿蒙自动化测试 Agent。</p>
<p>动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1htKA6VEmC/" rel="noopener nofollow">《1. DeepAgents 开箱，鸿蒙自动化测试 Agent 框架跑通》</a>。</p>

</div>
